SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat transfer? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat transfer.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat transfer.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat transfer.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat transfer.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Heat transfer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Classification of Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
